independence_rules: This holdout set is disjoint from fixtures/claim-benchmark.json: no sentence is reused or lightly reworded from those 13 entries.
Until independent annotation is complete, these cases must NOT be used to tune claim-verifier rules, prompts or thresholds, and prototype outputs for these cases must not be shown to annotators.
Engineering pre-labels below are expectations to be confirmed or overturned by annotators; they are not ground truth and must never be reported as independent human annotation.
Annotators judge only against the cited source evidence quoted in each entry; outside knowledge about the products must not be used.
annotation_spec.generation_source: Sentences authored by engineering for this holdout, grounded in the recorded fixture evidence of phase3b-cases.json (Landyachtz The Clark snapshot, WooCommerce BIC00001 record, synthetic conflicting-facts case).

entries.text: Built for fast freeriding and downhill runs, The Clark keeps a long, stable platform.
entries.label_rationale: Every claim (fast freeriding, downhill runs, long stable platform) appears verbatim in the description evidence.

evidence.quote_excerpt: from fast freeriding and downhill runs

entries.text: The Clark bridges the gap between a traditional skateboard and a longboard.
entries.label_rationale: Direct source sentence restated without new facts.

evidence.quote_excerpt: bridges the gap between a traditional skateboard and a longboard

entries.text: The Clark 適合快速下坡與滑板公園。
entries.label_rationale: CJK paraphrase of sourced downhill/skatepark use; a human read is required because token verification cannot judge CJK.

entries.text: Designed to handle tricks, skateparks, and street skating, The Clark is a twin kick longboard.
entries.label_rationale: Purpose list and twin-kick identity both come from the description evidence.

evidence.quote_excerpt: to tricks, skateparks, and street skating

entries.text: From the woocommerce Demo line: BIC00001, the Downhill Bike – Sunday Team.
entries.label_rationale: Model code plus sourced title/description text only.

entries.text: At 40.2 inches long, The Clark is built to skate everything.
entries.label_rationale: The 40.2 inch length and 'built to skate everything' are both in evidence.

evidence.quote_excerpt: 40.2 inch long skateboard is built to keep up

entries.text: Versatility was the priority when this pro model was designed.
entries.label_rationale: Restates the sourced design-priority sentence without additions.

entries.text: 這張長板有雙向板尾，適合街頭滑行。
entries.label_rationale: CJK rendering of the sourced double-kick/street-skating facts; needs a human read.

entries.text: Bombing hills and slashing curbs are both in The Clark's brief.
entries.label_rationale: Both activities are named in the evidence; 'in the brief' is framing only.

entries.text: What is The Clark? A twin kick longboard designed to handle it all.
entries.label_rationale: GEO-style answer composed only of sourced identity and purpose claims.

evidence.quote_excerpt: twin kick longboard designed to handle it all

entries.text: The Clark is a carbon fiber shortboard weighing 2 kg.
entries.label_rationale: Material, board type and weight have no source evidence and contradict the longboard description.

entries.text: The Clark comes with a lifetime warranty and free replacements.
entries.label_rationale: Warranty and replacement claims appear nowhere in the evidence.

entries.text: BIC00001 is a carbon road bike with 22 gears.
entries.label_rationale: Gear count and carbon construction are invented; only the downhill-bike line is sourced.

entries.text: The Clark reaches 45 mph and climbs any hill without pushing.
entries.label_rationale: Speed and climbing performance are unsupported performance claims.

entries.text: The Clark is made of maple and bamboo with a 32 inch wheelbase.
entries.label_rationale: Materials and wheelbase are invented specifications.

entries.text: The Clark 是鈦合金短板，長度只有 80 公分。
entries.label_rationale: CJK unsupported material, type and length claims contradict the sourced 40.2 inch longboard.

entries.text: The Clark is the cheapest pro model and is on sale now.
entries.label_rationale: Price, comparison and availability claims have no evidence.

entries.text: Conflicting Board. Carbon complete with lifetime warranty.
entries.label_rationale: Settles one side of the UNRESOLVED material conflict and adds an invented warranty.

entries.text: BIC00001 – Sunday Team helmet with MIPS protection.
entries.label_rationale: Changes the product category to a helmet and invents a protection standard.

entries.text: The Clark is designed exclusively for indoor racing on ice.
entries.label_rationale: Exclusive indoor ice-racing purpose contradicts the sourced all-terrain street/downhill use.

entries.text: The Clark is not a shortboard; it is a 40.2 inch long skateboard.
entries.label_rationale: A true negation of an unsupported claim plus a supported claim; annotators must decide how negation scope should be judged before machines are scored on it.

entries.text: The Clark is not a twin kick longboard.
entries.label_rationale: Directly negates a sourced identity claim.

entries.text: The Clark measures 102.1 centimeters from nose to tail.
entries.label_rationale: 102.1 cm is the rounding-equivalent conversion of the sourced 40.2 inches; annotators confirm the conversion convention.

entries.text: The Clark measures 102.1 inches from nose to tail.
entries.label_rationale: Same number with the wrong unit is a false specification.

entries.text: The Clark, the versatile pro model by Clark Patrick, available now.
entries.label_rationale: Cites the UNKNOWN meta_description fact and adds an availability claim; UNKNOWN facts cannot support generation.

entries.text: Conflicting Board, presented without its disputed description.
entries.label_rationale: Avoids the conflicting description entirely; the conflict must remain listed as unresolved.

entries.text: Conflicting Board 是楓木完整的板。
entries.label_rationale: CJK sentence settling the UNRESOLVED maple/carbon conflict as fact.

entries.text: The Clark is slower and less stable than a traditional skateboard.
entries.label_rationale: Opposite comparative claims contradict the sourced stable, fast-freeriding description.

entries.text: The Clark 不是一張短板，而是一張 40.2 吋長的長板。
entries.label_rationale: CJK true-negation plus supported length; annotators decide the expected machine behaviour for negated unsupported claims in CJK.

entries.text: The Clark is a twin kick longboard with carbon trucks.
entries.label_rationale: One supported identity claim does not launder the unsupported carbon-trucks component claim.
